t: Duties Of Russian Members Of C.I.D

157 RUSSIAN SECTION
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. D. REGISTRY No. L. Q. D. ... 8/4 ... Headquarters, ... /9.4...）
June 19, 1929.

As a consequence of the influx of Russian refugees during the past few years the good order of the Russian population has become a serious problem from a police point of view, and is likely to become more so in the future. Everything possible must be done to deal effectively with the criminal and political elements of this section of community, and it is the duty of the Russian members of the Force, especially those attached to the C.I.D., to do their utmost to assist the Commissioner of Police and his officers in this work. To enable them to give this support in the most effective manner possible, it has been decided to place a senior C.I.D. officer in charge of all Russian members of the C.I.D., both at Stations and in the Foreign Section, to act as a medium between Headquarter officers and those at Stations and generally to co-ordinate criminal and political matters coming to the notice of the Police.

It is hoped that the Senior Detectives at Stations and others concerned will give their whole-hearted support to the officer chosen for this work, and will do everything possible to make the scheme a success. The idea is simply one of co-operation and has been introduced to reinforce the present system. It is not intended that it should result in any interference with or disturbance of the present routine in the Foreign Section or Stations.

R. C. Alers
A/Director of Criminal Investigation.

157 俄籍组
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处 登记处 编号 L. Q. D. ... 8/4 ... 总部，... /9.4...）
1929年6月19日。

鉴于过去几年俄籍难民的涌入，从警务角度来看，俄籍居民的治安秩序已成为一个严重问题，且未来可能愈发严峻。必须采取一切可能的措施，有效应对该社区群体中的犯罪和政治分子。警队中的俄籍成员，尤其是隶属于刑事侦缉处（C.I.D.）的成员，有责任竭尽全力协助警务总监及其下属官员开展此项工作。为了使他们能够以最有效的方式提供这种支持，已决定指派一名高级刑事侦缉处官员负责领导所有刑事侦缉处的俄籍成员，包括各捕房及外侨组的成员，充当总部官员与各捕房官员之间的联络中介，并总体协调警方所获悉的犯罪和政治事务。

希望各捕房的高级探员及其他相关人员能全心全意支持被选定负责此项工作的官员，并尽一切努力使该计划取得成功。这一构想纯粹是为了加强合作，旨在强化现有体系。其目的并非导致外侨组或各捕房现有日常工作受到任何干涉或扰乱。

R. C. Alers
代理刑事侦缉处处长。

CONTINUATION
SHEET.

Sir,

Further to remarks on Russian C.I.D. Branch.

The area covered by Russian C.I.D. is so vast that it would be impossible to cover it thoroughly without a large staff. The majority of the Russian criminals are located in the French Concession. A minority, however, are to be found in the International Settlement, chiefly in the northern portion of it, in the vicinity of ...

It would be more advisable for the Senior Detective to have his office situated at a station, say Louvre or Bubwell, which is centrally located and where he could command the services of the various stations.

The Senior Detective should not be exempt from Chinese cases, even if he is to be given one or two Russian cases, which only occur periodically (this does not include the petty larceny by the destitute class) as the time of the Senior Detective will then be occupied, but in the case of the Russian activities, owing to the various stations, it has usually engaged in special Russian criminal work, should carry on ordinary station work.

Owing to climate, etc., such invariably occurs in the hot summer months - June, July and August, as there is an exodus of the Russian crook to the crowded summer resorts, such as Mooloo, Tsingtau and also Japan. The Russian criminal who remains in Shanghai during these months, is a very poor craftsman and he lives on the earnings of his woman, who is a professional prostitute.

I would suggest that should there be a Russian C.I.D. Branch formed, same should not start to function until September, as to begin work for a new branch in a slack time, is not very interesting and is disappointing, because the results would be poor.

Yours obediently,

H. J. Schmidt.
D. I.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 刑事侦缉处 登记处 / 编号 L O. 捕房。/ 记录号 ...）

续页。

先生，

就俄籍刑事侦缉处分部事宜补充意见。

俄籍刑事侦缉处所管辖的区域如此广阔，若无大量人手，便无法彻底覆盖。大多数俄籍罪犯位于法租界。然而，少数罪犯可在公共租界找到，主要位于其北部区域，在……附近。

较为妥当的做法是，将高级探员的办公室设在一个捕房，例如老闸捕房或布韦尔捕房（音译），这些地点位置居中，便于他调动各捕房的人力。

即使分配给高级探员一两个俄籍案件（此类案件仅偶尔发生，不包括赤贫阶层的轻微盗窃），也不应免除其处理华籍案件的职责，因为这样会占用高级探员的时间；但在涉及俄籍活动方面，由于涉及各个捕房，通常从事专门的俄籍犯罪侦查工作，同时也应承担常规的捕房工作。

由于气候等原因，此类情况 invariably 发生在炎热的夏季月份——六月、七月和八月，因为俄籍窃贼会大批前往拥挤的避暑胜地，如莫洛（音译）、青岛以及日本。在此期间留在上海的俄籍罪犯手艺极差，依靠其女性伴侣的收入为生，而这些女性是职业妓女。

我建议，如果成立俄籍刑事侦缉处分部，该分部不应在九月之前开始运作，因为在淡季开展新分部的工作并无多大意义，且令人失望，因为成果将会寥寥无几。

您忠实的仆人，

H. J. Schmidt.
侦探督察。

May 29,. 1929.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

A/ 'D. C. I.,

The duties of Russian detectives at Stations
cannot be 'confined to enquiries into cases in which
Russian or Russian speaking persons are concerned.'
These detectives must assist in the general enquiry work
of the station to which they are attached. They should,
however, be supervised by a Senior Russian speaking
detective and occasionally meet together in conference
on matters appertaining to the foreign criminal element
in Shanghai.

I recommend that D.I. Schmidt be appointed
Senior Detective i/c of the Russian Section with
headquarters at Hongkew. The duties involved in this
connection could be undertaken, for the time being,
in addition to his present work at Hongkew Station.

I suggest these duties should include:-

General supervision over the work of Russian
detectives at Stations in so far as it affects Russian
speaking criminals and crimes committed, or believed to
have been committed, by Russian speaking criminals.
In this connection he will occasionally visit Stations
and consult with Senior detectives and Divisional
Superintendents.

If occasion arises, he will have authority,
after consultation with A. C. (Crime) and Divisional
Superintendents, to detail Russian detectives at Stations
on any special or particular duty, which may necessitate
their removal for a period from their ordinary station
work.

He will hold a conference of Russian
detectives in his office at Hongkew Station at least
once every month.

He will submit a monthly report to
A. C. (Crime) on the work performed by Russian detectives
at Stations affecting the Russian speaking criminal
element.

（批：Will you please draw up memo for circulation v D.P. order
29/5. Stay）

致 代理刑事侦缉处处长，

各捕房俄籍探员的职责不能“仅限于调查涉及俄籍或讲俄语人员的案件”。这些探员必须协助其所属捕房的一般调查工作。然而，他们应由一名资深讲俄语的探员进行监督，并偶尔召开会议，讨论有关上海外侨犯罪分子的事项。

我建议任命侦探督察 Schmidt 为俄籍组主管高级探员，总部设在虹口。与此相关的职责目前可由他在虹口捕房的现有工作兼任。

我建议这些职责应包括：

总体监督各捕房俄籍探员的工作，只要该工作涉及讲俄语的罪犯以及由讲俄语的罪犯实施或被认为由其实施的犯罪。在此方面，他将偶尔走访各捕房，并与高级探员及区巡官协商。

如有需要，经与助理处长（犯罪）及区巡官协商后，他有权调派各捕房的俄籍探员执行任何特殊或特定任务，这可能需要他们在一段时间内脱离常规的捕房工作。

他每月至少在虹口捕房他的办公室召开一次俄籍探员会议。

他将向助理处长（犯罪）提交月度报告，汇报各捕房俄籍探员针对讲俄语犯罪分子所开展的工作。

RUSSIAN - C.I.D. BRANCH

Sir,
65% of the criminal element here in Shanghai, consists mostly of Russians or the Russian speaking races, such as Russian, Polish, Russian Jews, etc. The greater part of this element are professional thieves, experts in their own line, such as shoplifters, pick pockets, confidence men etc.

The remainder are thieves from sheer necessity, being destitutes without any means or occupation, eking out an existence from begging or petty thieving. These petty thieves have no organization, and do not require any special attention from the C.I.D. Branch. The uniform branch should be able to deal with them, if seen loitering near unattended vehicles or in the vicinity of open doors of dwelling houses. They are vagrants of no fixed abode and when hungry or very hard up, often come to the station to give themselves up for some petty theft, asking to be sent to the gaol, where they are certain of receiving three good meals a day. Imprisonment for this type of offenders is no punishment. Work or emigration is the only solution.

The organized professional criminal is different, to deprive him of his liberty is a severe punishment, but to get concrete evidence against him; which would bring conviction is at times very difficult.

Constant observation and continuous annoyance by the C.I.D. will put them on the move. At any rate the crime committed by them here in Shanghai, can not be classed as very serious, there are months when several reports are received, but then again no serious Foreign crime is reported for several months. The professional Russian crook usually works in pairs, but very often one gang

俄籍 - 刑事侦缉处分部

先生，
上海这里的犯罪分子中，65%主要由俄籍或讲俄语的种族组成，如俄罗斯人、波兰人、俄籍犹太人等。这部分人中的大多数是职业窃贼，是其行当里的专家，如商店扒手、扒手、诈骗犯等。

其余的人则是出于纯粹的必要而成为窃贼，他们是没有任何生计或职业的赤贫者，靠乞讨或轻微偷窃勉强维持生存。这些轻微窃贼没有组织，不需要刑事侦缉处分部的特别关注。制服部门应该能够处理他们，如果发现他们在无人看管的车辆附近徘徊或在住宅敞开的大门附近逗留。他们是无固定住所的流浪者，当饥饿或极度贫困时，往往会主动到捕房自首，承认犯有轻微盗窃罪，要求被送进监狱，因为他们确信在那里每天能得到三顿饱饭。对此类罪犯而言，监禁并非惩罚。工作或移民才是唯一的解决办法。

有组织的专业罪犯则不同，剥夺其自由是一种严厉的惩罚，但要获取足以使其定罪的确凿证据，有时非常困难。

刑事侦缉处的持续监视和不断骚扰会迫使他们流动。无论如何，他们在上海所犯的罪行不能归类为非常严重，有些月份会收到几份报告，但随后又有几个月未报告严重的外侨犯罪。职业俄籍窃贼通常两人一组行动，但经常有一个团伙

consists of three or four members, such as the bank
thieves or confidence men.

If they are successful they do not remain here, but
depart to some other port, until things have quietened
down a bit. Several gangs of the same specialty will not
operate in the same place, as they interfere with each
other, and cause trouble. In such cases the detectives
will always receive information from a member of one gang,
accusing the other gang.

To form a special Russian C.I.D. Branch, with their
own office, centrally located, will not be necessary, as
there would not be enough continuous work for this branch,
but trained Russian detectives, now stationed at the
various stations, could be supervised by a Russian
speaking Senior Detective. They should keep in constant
touch with the Russian crook residing in his district,
they should be continuous interchange of information,
about criminals residing in their various districts.
This could be done by having regular conferences. The
Senior Detective should have authority to call the
Russian detectives away from their normal station work,
and place them on special work, should there be an occa-
sion to do so, of course the Senior Detective will be
held responsible.

The collection of information by the Foreign Section,
is not very valuable to the Russian C.I.D. members, as the
professional thief, as a rule, will not reside in a
licenced boarding house.

Conferences by members of the Russian C.I.D. super-
vised by a Senior Detective, who has the authority to put
them on special work at a moment's notice, would be very
useful in rounding or driving away the professional
Russian criminal.

由三到四名成员组成，例如银行窃贼或诈骗犯。

如果他们得手，就不会留在这里，而是前往其他港口，直到风声稍息。同一专长的几个团伙不会在同一地点作案，因为他们会互相干扰，引发麻烦。在这种情况下，探员总会从一个团伙的成员那里收到指控另一个团伙的情报。

没有必要成立一个拥有自己办公室、位置居中的专门俄籍刑事侦缉处分部，因为该分部不会有足够的连续工作量，但目前驻扎在各捕房的受过训练的俄籍探员可以由一名讲俄语的高级探员进行监督。他们应与居住在其辖区内的俄籍窃贼保持持续联系，并应不断交流关于居住在各辖区内的罪犯的信息。这可以通过定期会议来实现。高级探员应有权在必要时将俄籍探员从正常的捕房工作中调离，安排他们执行特殊任务，当然，高级探员需对此承担责任。

外侨组收集的情报对俄籍刑事侦缉处成员的价值不大，因为职业窃贼通常不会居住在持牌寄宿公寓中。

由一名有权随时指派他们执行特殊任务的高级探员监督的俄籍刑事侦缉处成员会议，对于围捕或驱逐职业俄籍罪犯将非常有用。
